label_caveat: Labels are a NAIVE prior-year-same-quarter proxy, NOT real analyst consensus (no point-in-time consensus provider at this scale yet -- see docs/DECISIONS.md D61/D62). The label set is beat-heavy (360/443 = 81.3%).
warning: None of the 3 models beat the trivial always-predict-beat baseline. Higher accuracy among the models largely reflects how often each one predicted 'beat' (closer to the label's true base rate), not necessarily better retrieval or reasoning -- see n_predicted_beat / pct_predicted_beat per model.
